description: Ahmad Hassan Textile Mills Limited was incorporated in Pakistan in 1989 and listed on the Karachi Stock Exchange in 1990. Its weaving division produces loom-state grey fabric and dyed fabric at a mill on M.M. Road, Chowk Sarwar Shaheed, in Muzaffargarh district, with the head office at 46 Hassan Parwana Colony, Multan. The company reports export sales of more than US$35 million and describes trading as part of its business alongside manufacturing.
sourceNote: Written from: Ahmad Hassan Textile Mills Limited website (ahtml.com.pk: home, company profile - board of directors, office and factories, contact us) (accessed 2026-10-17)
